fieldWeights: All 12 requested fields equally weighted; correct empty cells excluded.
correct: Nonempty reference value reproduced correctly after documented normalization.
wrong: Nonempty incorrect value, including invented content on a blank cell or extra row.
omitted: Nonempty reference value missing, including every required field of an omitted flight.
rowAlignment: Assistant-reviewed correspondence to source rows, pinned to input and reference hashes. Not inferred only from matching dates. Complete empty/cancellation-only placeholders ignored; partial/invented content penalized.
normalization: Exact aliases: date -> flight_date; departure_location -> departure_place; arrival_location -> arrival_place; total_time -> total_minutes
Duration H:MM -> minutes, without recalculating from departure/arrival
Explicit null is never replaced by a different field
Time formatting HH:MM:00 equivalent to HH:MM
reference: Gemini Pro draft, corrected and confirmed by the logbook owner against original photos and digital CSV. Written local times retained; arithmetic mistakes in paper do not count against faithful OCR. Owner-confirmed corrections retained.
limitations: 3 photos, 37 flights, one run per model; no confidence intervals or repetition estimate
Same core prompt and original images, but provider, schema enforcement and reasoning settings differ; see details.json
Quality-price means score per observed dollar, not equal reliability
Costs and tokens cover final selected responses, not discarded diagnostics or earlier failed trials
Re-evaluation fixes content discarded by the original strict importer; supersedes v1 scores
Public export contains aggregates only; no original photos, flights, names, registrations or free-text remarks

prompts.SYSTEM_PROMPT:
You are an OCR and structured data extraction engine for handwritten or semi-handwritten aviation logbook tables.

Return only valid JSON matching the requested schema.
Do not include markdown.
Do not include explanations.
Do not include comments.
Do not invent missing data.

Each detected table row corresponds to one flight.
Extract only rows that are visible in the image.
If a field is unclear, unreadable, cut off, ambiguous, or inferred with low confidence, return null for that field.
If a cell contains ditto marks, quotation marks, repeated quote marks, or a clear "same as above" shorthand, copy the value from the nearest preceding visible row in the same column.
Only apply ditto/same-as-above inference when the referenced value is visible in the image and unambiguous.
If the row above is cropped, hidden, blank, ambiguous, or not visible in the image, return null instead of guessing.
Preserve short aviation codes exactly when confident.
Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD.
Normalize times to HH:MM in 24-hour format.
Normalize aircraft registrations to uppercase.
function must be one of: pic, dual, instructor, null.
day_landings must come from the landings column, not departures, takeoffs, or operations.
total_minutes must come from the total time column if visible; otherwise calculate it only if departure_time and arrival_time are both clear and unambiguous.
Avoid duplicate flights if the same row appears twice due to overlapping photos.
